title: tecoma arequipensis
intro: Tecoma arequipensis, commonly known as the Arequipa Trumpet Vine, is a flowering plant species native to the Andean region of South America. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, helping to soothe various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma arequipensis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit analgesic and antispasmodic effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been identified as tecomaquinone, tecomarioside, and other glycosides.
